name: Puppet Rings
body:
Aura moderate abjuration; CL 10th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This pair of rings appear to be rings of friend shield. Unlike the rings’ intended purpose, one ring is Dominant and the other is Submissive. Once worn, the wearer of the Submissive ring must make a DC 25 Will saving throw or mimic all physical movements of the other wearer for the next 24 hours, including attack actions and somatic movements of spells. This saving throw must be made daily until the ring is removed.

The relative position of the two individuals remains the same as at the point the Submissive wearer failed his saving throw unless physically restrained from moving.

These rings can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon both rings simultaneously, which renders the rings non-magical. If one of the wearers dies, that ring may be removed freely. The other wearer may not remove his ring unless remove curse is cast upon both rings simultaneously or he puts on both rings. In this event, the rings shatter with a burst of force inflicting 10d6 points of damage to everyone within 10 feet (save Reflex DC 20 for half).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of friend shield

Identification DC 35
False Identification DC 25
